sealedNote: the sealed evaluation is NOT EXECUTED: the isolation it needs has not been established from this executor
timingNote: the wall and CPU times are machine state; they are RECORDED and are NOT asserted by any test, and the verdicts are read against the pre-registered rule rather than against a preference
timedPathCovers: the SERVED path of one request: the selection (the planner's scoring of the candidates), the retrieval statistics, the validation of the preconditions (the presence check and the question-specific adequacy check), the fallback and the writing of the artefact. This is the list of the stages the timing covers, NOT an exhaustive account of the work the process does
timedPathExcludes: the work that MAKES a competence: the learning episode, the promotion and the promotion's validation on the held-out cases. That work is measured once per competence, is reported under 'promotionValidationCost', and is deliberately NOT folded into the per-request medians
amortisationNote: the cold premium of a cell is the cost of building the statistics once; the requestsToAmortiseColdStart count is how many requests pay it back, if the warm difference holds
promotionValidationNote: the promotion and its validation are the work that MAKES a competence: the learner reads the retained journeys, derives the candidate's support, and checks the candidate against the held-out cases. The times are machine state, are RECORDED and are NOT asserted; they are reported separately because they happen once per competence and not once per request, and folding them into the per-request medians would make those medians depend on the number of requests a cell made
